verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot generates AI-driven code suggestions, chat insights, and contextual explanations drawn from the user's own repos/docs (agent mode, Autofix, shared source-of-truth context), which is well documented and corroborated by extensive hands-on community use showing real (if variable) productivity gains. Missing for 10: independent quantitative benchmarking of suggestion accuracy/insight quality and consistent cross-IDE parity (chat/agent features vary by editor).
